source.taken: every my_test_model call of the driver's suites 0 to 4, as data: the case's suite and number, its line, the fixture, the radius, the edge index intervals and whether they include or exclude, the solver, the flags, and the edge count the driver asserts for constant-radius fillets; a branch the driver never takes (if (0)) is left out. The selected edges and the outcomes are not the driver's: they are what the oracle harness found.

oracle.build: SMLib's reference build: every source of source/SMLib/src and of tests/prog_test/src at usd-brep's pinned commit, compiled with g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -DNDEBUG -DNOMINMAX -DSM_GRAPHICS_CALLBACKS=1 -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math, the flags of solidcore's reference build
oracle.harness: the smlib-fillet harness of the oracle repository: one case of the driver per process (my_test_suite_<n> with the count before the case, constant-radius solvers, as the driver's own regression runs), answering SMLib's status, whether it left a body, and the body's edge count; and each fixture's edges in SmBrep::GetEdges order, with whether SmEdge::GetBlendEdgeuse finds a sector

not_lifted.why: a fillet between two separate surfaces, not edges of one body
